source: lab (captured; 'Modified with Segment Anything 2 Demo' watermark bottom-right)
time_convention: t = frame / 24; frame = round(t * 24); frame 0 at t = 0
units: pixels and seconds; image coords x right, y down, origin top-left

camera.motion: static (background diff between consecutive frames ~0.02-0.08 grey levels mean in static regions; no pan/shake)

perspective.ground_plane: table top (horizontal), quad given in static_objects.table
perspective.horizon_note: intersection of table side edges gives the depth VP; front/back edges converge far to the left (~x=-3700,y=325) so horizon is nearly level (slope ~0.005), ~11 px above the principal point => camera pitched down ~0.8 deg; approximate (+-10 px)
perspective.camera_roll: table front edge slopes down to the right (536->586 over x 212->1137) mostly because the table is yawed relative to the camera

moving_objects.name: ball
moving_objects.description: small white ping-pong ball (orange/black logo visible while at rest), the only moving object
moving_objects.reference_point: ref_x, ref_y = centre of circle fitted to the upper ~60% of the ball outline (f0-40); bbox centre for f41-44 (motion blurred while falling)
moving_objects.apparent_size_note: ball approaches the camera: diameter grows ~23 -> 48 px (f18 -> f40), i.e. depth roughly halves (Z proportional to 1/diameter for a sphere)

static_objects.name: table
static_objects.description: wooden table (light-brown top, dark front face) in the middle of the frame; ball rolls on it
static_objects.front_edge_y_at_x: y = 536 + 0.054*(x-212) (e.g. y~550 at x=470 where the ball leaves the table)

static_objects.name: pink_bottle
static_objects.description: pink insulated bottle/thermos with cream band near top, standing on table behind cards, left of white cup

static_objects.name: white_cup
static_objects.description: white tumbler/cup (wider at top) right of the pink bottle

static_objects.name: card_tent
static_objects.description: two playing cards leaning against each other (tent), blue-striped back facing camera, in front of the pink bottle

static_objects.name: flat_cards
static_objects.description: playing cards lying flat (spread deck) on table in front of the card tent

static_objects.name: phone
static_objects.description: dark blue flat rectangle (phone or card case) lying on the table near the front edge, yellow sticker on its right end

static_objects.name: tripod
static_objects.description: black tripod behind the table, blue light/sensor on top at (688,70)

static_objects.name: person
static_objects.description: person seated behind/under the table: only legs/knees under the table and a hand (fingertips behind the ball f0-~20, then withdrawing) are visible

static_objects.name: monitor
static_objects.description: dark wall-mounted screen top right with a bright light reflection

static_objects.name: left_stand
static_objects.description: dark tripod/light-stand poles at the left image edge

static_objects.name: wall_panels
static_objects.description: grey partition panels forming the room background

events.event: ball at rest on the back of the table, held/steadied by a hand behind it
segmentation artefact: ball greyed out (outline visible, ball still at rest)
release / start of motion (first clear displacement)
events.note: f18 shows <1 px change; motion clearly starts between f18 and f19

events.event: ball rolls on table toward camera and to the left (image direction ~ down-left)
probable dropped/irregular frame: image displacement f35->f36 is ~12 px vs ~5.5 px for neighbours
ball reaches the table front edge and rolls off
events.note: f40 ball bottom ~546 px, edge at ~550 px; f41 centre already near the edge line

events.event: falling in front of the table front face (strong motion blur)
ball leaves the image through the bottom edge
